title: The Elder Sister-Like One
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yuu, orphaned at five and passed between cold relatives, opens a forbidden storeroom at his uncle's house and summons Chiyo, an eldritch being with goat horns and tendrils who calls herself the 'Sister of the Woods with a Thousand Young'. He wishes for family, and she agrees to be his elder sister in exchange for something he values, sealing the pact with a kiss. The series follows their rural daily life as their bond deepens; it is adapted from an adult doujinshi of the same title.
life_message: It holds up belonging and being loved as worth any price, even a pact with something not human.
